question:
Give the name of the league with the highest matches of all time and how many matches were played in the said league.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: league with highest matches of all time refers to MAX(COUNT(league_id));

prediction.sql:
SELECT L.XCL_005, COUNT(M.XCL_006) AS match_count
FROM League L
JOIN Match M ON L.XCL_003 = M.XCL_008
GROUP BY L.XCL_003, L.XCL_005
ORDER BY match_count DESC
LIMIT 1;
